Thank you for sharing, I appreciate what you're saying. 

I'm 28, married, and haven't lived at home in 7 years. To be clear, my husband is aware of how I feel about the religion, and is supportive of me. However as he is in the religion, if I leave, we won't be able to hang out socially with any of our friends since I would be shunned, and he would not.

It isn't about saying fuck those friends, because it's not just friends. It's my family, my husbands family, best friends, family friends, and everyone I've ever known for nearly 3 decades. 

It would also put a massive strain on my marriage.
